sourcePolicy.bankIdentity: SHA-256 of complete native DTPK bytes
sourcePolicy.duplicatePolicy: Byte-identical banks are one record with every disc path retained.
sourcePolicy.semanticPolicy: Families derive only from source filenames; command purposes require independent script, executable, motion, or emulator evidence.
sourcePolicy.streamPolicy: AFS archives are inventoried by path and size only in this catalog; their entry-level dialogue/stream extraction remains separate.
